**Tax Evasion** is an Expedition in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* update. [1] 

Tax Evasion appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* update.

1. ↑ Fallout 76 Patch 1.7.8.8: *"Billy Beltbuckles, the mafia's "accountant" needs your help cooking the books, if you catch the drift. A little smudge in the books here, some misplaced money over there, whatever you can do to avoid paying dues to the Showmen and Munis. Death and taxes wait for no one, and being terrified of conflict means Billy will need your help on a regular basis.* "
